greeting.text: Marx Francois, aide to the Wizard King. I keep the records of this Sanctuary. You are {player}, I assume.
I was expecting you, {player}. The Wizard King announces newcomers before they arrive. Please do not ask how.
Welcome to the Sanctuary. Rule one: nothing in the dungeon is safe. Rule two: everything here is. Do not confuse them.
Your record is already extensive, {player}. I will need to update several ledgers.
Back again. Good. I dislike unfinished records.

hint.text: A party is the Magic Knights' oldest tool. Your team shares one chain of floors, and a team's progress belongs to the team.
The System tracks your floor quests and rewards inside the dungeon. Its bonuses sleep outside and wake when you return. Nothing is lost.
Every tenth floor has a Guardian, a Gatekeeper door and a vault. The way on lies behind them. There is no way around.
Safe Zones and Landings are the only places where you recover properly. I record this because people keep dying beside them anyway.
A Charter Grimoire may fall to the first one to defeat a champion, once per world, by chance. Hold it and it lends its skills; put it away and they return.
Champions follow a chain. One opens only when the ones before it have fallen. The Chronicle lists which are open and which are not.
Each floor is a level of its own: you arrive at the foot of a stair and must find the way on. If the stairs say they are still forming, wait. Do not run back.
Wandering champions patrol the halls between the guardian floors. A quiet hall is not an empty one.
Some pages answer only to the grimoire of one particular person. That is by design. Please file it under: not a bug.
I have asked the Wizard King several times to keep a schedule. He says time is not a schedule. I note it for the records.
The records currently place you in: {saga}.
No champions on file. Per protocol, I recommend the lower floors of either road, and a party.
Your current concern is the Eye of the Midnight Sun. Their chain is long. Do not skip links.
Zagred: file closed, pending a review of the aftermath. Please do not reopen it.
The Spade Kingdom files are now open to you. Warning: the Zogratis family uses curses that persist. Do not descend further while marked.
The file on Lucius Zogratis opens only in his arena. Standing order: nobody enters alone. Anyone within reach of the Hourglass bearer travels with them, seven companions at most.
Once the fight has begun, the arena is closed to latecomers, and leaving takes ten seconds. Gather everyone first. I will not be filing a rescue report.
New files keep arriving from worlds I have not catalogued. I have stopped asking where they come from.
Warning on file: fighters from other worlds do not follow Clover Kingdom protocol. Plan accordingly.

farewell.text: Return alive. The paperwork is shorter.
Report back when you have results.
Good luck. Strictly speaking, I am not permitted to say that.
